# Redhawk Grille

> Restaurant and bar at 7481 Auburn Rd, Concord, OH 44077 (Painesville mailing area, near Mentor), Lake County, Ohio. Phone 440-354-4040. Scratch-made American food, two full-service bars, a large outdoor patio with bocce and cornhole, a wood-burning fireplace, live music on weekends, and private events.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://www.redhawkgrille.com/): overview, hours, location, live music
- [Menu](https://www.redhawkgrille.com/menu/): full menu with prices in plain text
- [Private Events](https://www.redhawkgrille.com/private-events/): rehearsal dinners, birthdays, showers, corporate, fundraisers
- [Join the Crew](https://www.redhawkgrille.com/careers/): jobs and quick application
